raw_results.title: User Presence vs User Verification - Yubico
raw_results.content: User presence - this most basic configuration is nothing more than a FIDO2 call that prompts the user to touch the security key or interact in some way with the authenticator. User verification - a FIDO2 call where the authenticator verifies that the user is authorized to use the authenticator, and signals to the RP whether user verification was successful.
